page_title: PSG 3-0 LIL | PSG v Lille 16/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+4' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Romain Perraud (Lille) inside the box. He lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Lucas Chevalier was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
90+3' 3 - 0 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Bradley Barcola (PSG), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 3:0.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Bruno Genesio prepares a substitution. Hakon Arnar Haraldsson is replaced by Felix Correia (Lille).
87' The substitution has been made. Thomas Meunier (Lille) has replaced Tiago Santos.
86' PSG failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
85' Nuno Mendes (PSG) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy. PSG have a corner.
84' It will be a substitution. Lucas Hernandez (PSG) is ready to enter the pitch as Desire Doue walks off.
83' Excellent touch by Soriba Diaoune (Lille)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save.
81' PSG work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

80' Desire Doue (PSG) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the top right corner. Berke Ozer is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. PSG earn a corner.
79' PSG keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ngalayel Mukau leaves the pitch and Osame Sahraoui (Lille) comes on.
77' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ethan Mbappe walks off the pitch to be replaced by Marius Broholm (Lille).
77' Bruno Genesio decides to make a substitution. Olivier Giroud will be replaced by Soriba Diaoune (Lille).
77' Here's the change. Ousmane Dembele leaves the pitch and Goncalo Ramos (PSG) comes on as a substitute.
76' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
72' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lille comes to nothing.
70' So close! Desire Doue (PSG) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.

69' PSG slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
66' The total number of attempts is 8:6.
64' 2 - 0 GOAL! Ousmane Dembele (PSG) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Berke Ozer, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 2:0.
63' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by PSG, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
63' The referee allows time for a substitution. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia will be replaced by Bradley Barcola (PSG).
62' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) was quite harsh and Jerome Brisard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
62' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lille, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
60' Poor challenge! Vitinha (PSG) is penalised for tripping and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle. Lille are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

60' Nuno Mendes (PSG) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
57' Nuno Mendes (PSG) has a goal ruled out for offside!
56' Desire Doue (PSG) hits a shot towards the right side of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Berke Ozer.
54' PSG seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
51' Nuno Mendes (PSG) was too forceful with his tackle and Jerome Brisard interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
49' PSG take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
48' Desire Doue (PSG) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
46' Luis Enrique has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Ilya Zabarnyi (PSG) comes on the pitch for Senny Mayulu.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Jerome Brisard has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Vitinha (PSG) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
41' None of the PSG players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
40' Great teamplay by PSG as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
38' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) commits a foul and Jerome Brisard immediately signals a free kick.
36' Olivier Giroud (Lille) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
36' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) is penalised for a foul. Jerome Brisard had a clear view and blows his whistle.
33' PSG couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Berke Ozer (Lille) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
32' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. PSG will take a free kick near the side line.
29' Desire Doue (PSG) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Berke Ozer is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
28' PSG keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
26' The referee blows his whistle after Olivier Giroud (Lille) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
26' Nuno Mendes (PSG) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
22' Jerome Brisard blows for a foul after Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
20' Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
19' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
17' Senny Mayulu (PSG) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
15' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from PSG.

13' 1 - 0 Ousmane Dembele (PSG) controls the ball on the edge of the box after a superb low pass by Vitinha. He makes a yard for himself and fires a wonderful strike into the bottom left corner via the post. 1:0!

10' The cross into the penalty area from Vitinha (PSG) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
8' PSG control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
6' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Lucas Chevalier is alert and denies him with a nice save.
5' Desire Doue (PSG) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball is out of play. Lille will have a throw-in.
3' Lille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

2' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball low towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Lucas Chevalier, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lille.
2' Olivier Giroud (Lille) gets a shot from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar!
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! PSG will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Jerome Brisard.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
